commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseMDSExtract == 1 ]; then
    if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
      $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ac-extract/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-x Pub_MURX_SCPR_1700 -t 163000"
    else
      $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ac-extract/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-x Pub_MURX_SCPR_1700 -d $BusinessDate -t 163000"
    fi
else
    if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
      AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/murex/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_MURX_SCPR_BND_1700,Pub_MURX_SCPR_LOAN -t 163000 -i
    else
      AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/murex/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_MURX_SCPR_BND_1700,Pub_MURX_SCPR_LOAN,Pub_MURX_SCPR_EQS_CB -t 163000 -i
    fi
fi
